messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday fell on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day was on Sunday, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, giving you a 3‑day break. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday was on Friday, so the following weekend (Sat 8 – Sun 9) is a long weekend. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday, so the preceding weekend (Sat 20 – Sun 21) is a long weekend. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, giving you a 3‑day break. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday, so the preceding weekend (Sat 2 – Sun 3) is a long weekend. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday, so the preceding weekend (Sat 7 – Sun 8) is a long weekend. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, giving you a 3‑day break. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas | Christmas was on Monday, so the preceding weekend (Sat 23 – Sun 24) is a long weekend. |

---

### Provincial/Regional Long Weekends (optional)

Some provinces observe additional holidays that also create long weekends. If your app needs province‑specific data, here are the key ones for 2023:

| Province | Holiday | Date | Long‑Weekend Dates |
|----------|---------|------|--------------------|
| Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario | Family Day | Feb 20 2023 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Feb 20 2023 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 2023 (Monday) | Jun 22 – 24 |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 2023 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Nova Scotia | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 2023 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Prince Edward Island | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 2023 (Friday) | Mar 17 – 19 |
| Yukon | Family Day | Feb 20 2023 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Northwest Territories | Family Day | Feb 20 2023 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| Nunavut | Family Day | Feb 20 2023 (Monday) | Feb 18 – 20 |

> **Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, consider letting users select their province so you can filter the list accordingly.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full calendar for each province or any other details!
